limitations: CALM reports Parasail Needleman-Wunsch and identity times coverage, but does not publish its substitution matrix, gap penalties, exact coverage denominator, or optimal-alignment tie policy; this is therefore a transparent CALM-inspired secondary audit, not a bitwise reproduction.
A global-alignment identity threshold is one operational definition of sequence novelty and does not establish structural, epitope, functional, temporal, or prospective independence.
Both audited partitions are development splits. Passing this audit does not convert validation into an external test set and does not authorize opening any frozen test data.

Primary antibody identity follows the active heavy-light concatenation key. Separate VH and VL results are reported as a stricter supplementary sensitivity analysis and are deliberately not folded into primary validity.

policy.aligned_region_identity_definition: identical residue-residue columns / all residue-residue columns; gap columns are excluded from this denominator
policy.calm_scaled_similarity_definition: aligned-region identity * min(train coverage, validation coverage), equivalently identical residue-residue columns / max(full lengths)
policy.enumeration: all unique train x validation sequence pairs; pairs below the declared length-ratio bound are rejected without alignment because neither rule can mathematically be reached
policy.optimal_traceback_policy: first deterministic traceback returned by the pinned Biopython runtime
policy.reciprocal_coverage_definition: paired residue-residue columns / full raw length of the corresponding sequence
